newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton output reaches 8.167 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton output reaches 8.167 mln bales.

text.p: The state-run Cotton Export Corporation of Pakistan said on Tuesday cotton output had reached a provisional 8.167 million 375-lb bales by February 6 in the 1996/97 (July-June) crop year, down from 9.25 million bales in the same period last year.
It said mills had purchased 6.355 million bales, down from 6.703 million in the year-ago period, while exporters had bought only 3,900 bales against 1.010 million last year.
Ginning factories held unsold stocks of 1.807 million bales compared with 1.537 million a year earlier.

Officials believe 1996/97 cotton production will not exceeed nine million bales due to pest damage in the Punjab province cotton belt in recent months. Early forecasts put the crop at 10 million bales. Pakistan produced 9.96 million bales in 1995/96.
